more.themeDefaultDescription: Enable dark theme when enabled on the device.

crashReporting.title: Help improve the app
crashReporting.message: If the app crashes, an anonymous report with the error and device info can be sent to the developer. No personal data is included. You can change this at any time in the More tab.

today.empty:

report.title: Hunger per day
report.subtitle: Last {{count}} days
report.empty:
No data to show yet.
Log hunger to see your report.

modeToggle.title: Track or log
modeToggle.body: Track hunger as it happens, or log an episode that already ended.

intensity.title: Rate the intensity
intensity.body: Mark how strong the hunger feels — low, medium, or high.

startButton.title: Start a session
startButton.body: Go ahead — tap Start to begin. You'll set the details next.

focus.title: Focus issues
focus.body: Flag it when hunger makes it hard to focus.

stop.title: Stop when done
stop.body: Tap Stop to end the session and save it to your history.

tabOverview.title: Find your history
tabOverview.body: Today lists what you logged, and Report charts your trends over time.

complete.title: Tour complete
complete.body: Start a hunger session whenever you like.
